headline: Iran's Isfahan Province Exports Rise 54% to $1.1 Billion Over Eight Months
summary: Customs authorities reported that exports from Iran's central Isfahan Province rose by 54% in value, reaching $1.1 billion during the first eight months of the Iranian calendar year.
why: Isfahan Province is a major industrial and manufacturing center in Iran, producing metals, petrochemicals, and textiles.
